metadata.source: CORE 10 Master Decision Book / REQUIREMENTS LOCK

requirements.ownerRequirement: Provide one reusable Business Simulation Engine and central Business Simulation Lab within existing CORE-10-CENTRAL; no new app or duplicate ERP.
requirements.acceptance: Central lab discoverable; unified typed engine, reusable contextual components and tests.

requirements.ownerRequirement: Expose Quick Simulation in relevant business workflow menus (inventory, purchasing, production, sales, pricing, staffing, logistics, projects, funding, finance, cashflow, expansion) only when supported by valid inputs.
requirements.acceptance: Context correctly prefilled and scoped; unsupported contexts do not show invented calculations.

requirements.ownerRequirement: Use deterministic typed quantities/units/currency/periods and versioned, tested formulas; show assumptions, missing data, tax/cost basis, uncertainty and sensitivity. Estimates never masquerade as guaranteed profit.
requirements.acceptance: Reference calculation fixtures and reconciliation to authoritative sources; unknown never coerced to 0.

requirements.ownerRequirement: Keep scenarios, historical snapshots and comparisons separate from REAL stock, accounting, payroll, ledger, invoice and investor history. Any Apply-to-Plan uses explicit diff, role-authorized approval, transactional workflow and audit.
requirements.acceptance: No simulation writes operational ledger/state; approved actions auditable, reversible where permitted, idempotent.

requirements.ownerRequirement: Enforce platform/tenant/business/site/user permission, RLS/API boundaries, scenario visibility, audit and exports; independently licensed tenant owners keep control of their own operational data; vendor has no covert global data read.
requirements.acceptance: Cross-tenant negative tests, role visibility tests, legal data boundaries and no global-bypass privileges.

requirements.ownerRequirement: Master Platform Owner controls proprietary software, license issuance, capability packs, entitlements and optional future sales; separate platform IP control from each customer's legal operational data and tenant ownership.
requirements.acceptance: Owner-governed licensing with explicit grants; tenant ownership independent; billing/SaaS rollout remains separate deferred task.

requirements.ownerRequirement: REV-010 latest Owner correction: Claude Code may START isolated Simulation Engine DRAFT coding immediately in the SAME repository on a separate branch/Draft PR; no merging, deployment, actual customer data or production integration. Original two-to-three fully verified major packages and all A018–A023/P0 security gates remain prerequisites before main/production activation.
requirements.acceptance: Separate Claude Code implementation Draft PR with genuine code/tests, versioned model registry, decision log and handover; remains UNMERGED/NOT DEPLOYED. Release remains BLOCKED until named milestone and security evidence. Docs-only mandate PR #75 is not a completed module.

requirements.ownerRequirement: Provide configurable industry-specific templates, mobile/desktop responsive UX, localization BN/Bng-Eng/EN, save/compare/export scenario snapshots, charts, permissions and reliable offline/online behavior where supported.
requirements.acceptance: All enabled industry modules covered by QA, simulation types and role-scoped reports; no template marked ready before E2E tests.

requirements.ownerRequirement: U01 — Trusted Baseline Engine (P0): Pull only authorized tenant/business/site/period operational snapshots, preserve source record IDs and transaction cutoffs; prevent accidental mixture of stale sources.
requirements.acceptance: Given same authorized source snapshot and scope, baselines are reproducible and inaccessible to other businesses.

requirements.ownerRequirement: U02 — Data Quality & Readiness (P0): Identify missing, stale, incomplete, estimated and unverified inventory/cost/sales/finance data; add explicit data readiness flags and corrective prompts.
requirements.acceptance: Unknown is not zero; incomplete financial results cannot masquerade as certified profit/cashflow.

requirements.ownerRequirement: U03 — Certified Model Registry (P0): Register typed formulas, numeric units, supported business packs, dependencies, versions, tested/partial/unavailable status and fixture certification.
requirements.acceptance: Unverified models cannot be tagged Ready, and saved outputs retain the exact original formula version.

requirements.ownerRequirement: U04 — Financial Definition Engine (P0): Canonical revenue, contribution, cost, margin, net profit, cashflow, debt/equity/interest, returns, taxes, fiscal periods, currency and accounting basis definitions.
requirements.acceptance: Different pages using the same canonical business data and period agree or explain the difference.

requirements.ownerRequirement: U05 — Scenario Provenance (P0): Capture model ID/version, data snapshot hash/ref, inputs/overrides, units, author, source time, business/location/period, warnings and history.
requirements.acceptance: Saved scenarios can be reproduced without changing historical interpretation when live ERP data later changes.

requirements.ownerRequirement: U06 — Cross-Module Impact Engine (P0): Link effects on stock, purchasing, recipes/BOM, manufacturing, delivery, sales, staff, cash, financial obligations and approvals; apply explicit dependency graph without implicit double counting.
requirements.acceptance: Branch expansion example shows upstream production/supply/cash effects and explains missing links.

requirements.ownerRequirement: U07 — Feasibility & Constraint Engine (P0): Budget, cash buffer, supplier lead time, transport, plant/warehouse capacity, staff hours, machine throughput, space, project limits and availability windows.
requirements.acceptance: An infeasible decision is identified with exact breached constraint; it is not shown as readily executable.

requirements.ownerRequirement: U08 — Integrated Financial Modeling (P0): Link profit-and-loss, timing of receipts/payments, working capital, assets/liabilities, loans, principal, investor distribution and restricted cash; staged balance-sheet logic only where ledger contracts support it.
requirements.acceptance: Illustrative profitable-but-cash-negative scenario reconciles, no principal repayment counted as operating expense by mistake.

requirements.ownerRequirement: U09 — Sensitivity & Driver Analysis (P0): One-way, multi-variable and break-even threshold impact of price, volume, cost, lead time, discount, FX, rent, staff and term length.
requirements.acceptance: Top drivers and exact assumption deltas reconcile to base scenario; all variable bounds validated.

requirements.ownerRequirement: U10 — Risk & Stress Testing (P1): Named shocks and combined stress cases: demand fall, inflation, interest/return obligation, vendor delay, breakdown, staffing shortage and project slippage.
requirements.acceptance: Every stress result displays assumptions and range, not a claimed guaranteed future outcome.

requirements.ownerRequirement: U11 — Reverse Goal Planning (P1): Target profit, cash reserve, sales, working capital, service level or capacity with inverse calculation of feasible price/volume/cost and resource requirements.
requirements.acceptance: Shows when target is impossible under existing constraints instead of inventing unattainable numbers.

requirements.ownerRequirement: U12 — Constraint-Based Optimization (P1): Compare feasible resource/budget/capacity/stock/production allocation choices against owner-selected objective (cash, margin, service, risk).
requirements.acceptance: Result declares objective and tradeoffs; honors all hard constraints and never substitutes recommendation for owner approval.

requirements.ownerRequirement: U13 — Multi-Scenario Portfolio (P1): Combine owner-authorized scenarios across same portfolio/business/period and expose concurrent capex, cash, people, stock and machine contention.
requirements.acceptance: Two individually feasible branch expansions with joint cash shortage are flagged; no independent tenant blending.

requirements.ownerRequirement: U14 — Advanced Uncertainty Models (P2): Optional probability/range or Monte Carlo only with validated input distributions, correlations, model suitability and documented confidence limits.
requirements.acceptance: Missing statistical basis disables probability claims; output clearly distinguishes illustration from calibrated probability.

requirements.ownerRequirement: U15 — Decision Lifecycle Register (P0): Draft → Simulated → Reviewed → Approved/Rejected → Eligible-to-Apply → Applied → Monitored → Closed with actor/role/timestamp and state history.
requirements.acceptance: No direct skipping of required approval gates; approved decisions remain traceable to exact scenario/version.

requirements.ownerRequirement: U16 — Approval Workflow Integration (P0): Reuse canonical ERP request/approval service with financial/operational authority, segregation of duties and delegated thresholds.
requirements.acceptance: No new parallel approval engine; rejected/unauthorized execution is blocked at server.

requirements.ownerRequirement: U17 — Actual vs Plan Tracking (P0): Store baseline plan from approved simulation and reconcile future real P&L, volumes, stock, staff, capital and cash outcomes with period/location scopes.
requirements.acceptance: After 30/90 days actuals, variance is derived from verifiable records and planned assumptions.

requirements.ownerRequirement: U18 — Decision Performance Review (P0): Owner sees actual net benefit, liquidity impact, constraint incidence, ROI/payback when valid, variance reasons and retrospective decision notes.
requirements.acceptance: Reviewed case shows realized vs projected outcome without rewriting the historical simulation.

requirements.ownerRequirement: U19 — Forecast Accuracy & Bias (P1): Track comparable forecast-vs-actual accuracy by model, input data period, business, category and horizon; identify persistent bias.
requirements.acceptance: Quality checks handle missing actuals, data leakage, changed definitions and incomparable periods.

requirements.ownerRequirement: U20 — Early Warning & Replanning (P1): Detect cash gaps, stockout, capacity bottlenecks, financing due, large variance and delays; propose refresh/replan, optional authorized alert workflows.
requirements.acceptance: Owner sees evidence and threshold; no automation silently modifies the operational plan.

requirements.ownerRequirement: U21 — Collaborative Scenario Review (P1): Role-scoped scenario comments, reviewer roles, business manager/accountant/production advice, attachments and review evidence.
requirements.acceptance: Staff cannot retrieve restricted finance details/other businesses through collaboration or exported reports.

requirements.ownerRequirement: U22 — Multi-Business Consolidation (P0): Business/brand/site/factory/warehouse/project comparisons with tenant boundaries, elimination of internal movements, compatible currency/period/accounting bases.
requirements.acceptance: Portfolio summary reconciles without double counting internal transfer or external tenant data.

requirements.ownerRequirement: U23 — Investment & Financing Integration (P0): Draw on verified partner/loan agreement definitions: equity, actual-profit shares, principal-based contractual return, loan, repayment/interest, maturity, investor liquidity claims.
requirements.acceptance: Financing cases show cash obligations and classification accurately; no global all-locations aggregation bug.

requirements.ownerRequirement: U24 — Secure Scenario Application (P0): Separate simulation read sandbox from proposals; explicit before/after diff, permission and approvals, only domain-validated transactional action, idempotency and audit/recovery; unsupported Apply remains advisory-only.
requirements.acceptance: No unapproved changes to sales/stock/payroll/accounting; direct RPC bypass attempts denied.

requirements.ownerRequirement: U25 — Enterprise UX & Reporting (P0): One Simulation Lab + Contextual Quick Simulation, BN/EN support, mobile/tablet/desktop, charts, comparative tables, saved search/export, usable accessibility and safe errors.
requirements.acceptance: Same model yields same result in both entry points; responsive role-scoped UI and exported reports work end-to-end.

requirements.ownerRequirement: U26 — Security, Licensing & Scale (P0): RLS/RPC/backend tenant/business/site/user action gates, scenario entitlements, access revocation, authorized cache/offline, bounded compute and 300+ site performance tests.
requirements.acceptance: Real signed-in cross-tenant negatives and 300+ site benchmark must pass before claiming enterprise-ready.
